notes.drawing: Direction A, side view: the cabin and tail boom as one outline, the cockpit window as a quarter of the nose, main rotor and mast, a tail fin and skids on two struts.
notes.fill: The cabin is solid; the window's edges are cut as white lines, so the window is a separate solid piece, the way Phosphor's fills separate parts. Rotor, mast, fin and skids stay lines.
notes.bold: The tail boom is 8 units taller (y 100 to 140) and the fin 8 units longer, so the boom keeps a 16-unit opening; at the regular size only 8 stayed and it read as a solid bar.
